facts.fact: The document states that President Barrow assented the Personal Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2025 on 7 November 2025, the country's first comprehensive data protection law, and that it has no grace period before it becomes enforceable; it gives no commencement date.
facts.system: Personal Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2025

facts.fact: The document says the Act provides a data protection authority, the Commission, which assesses cross-border transfers and may impose conditions, but it does not say the Commission is constituted or its members appointed; undated, so the publication date of 2026-02-09 is used.
facts.system: Personal Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2025

facts.fact: The document refers to regulations and guidance still to be issued under the Act, on research purposes, the income base for fines and transfers, so none were in force; undated, so the publication date of 2026-02-09 is used.
facts.system: Personal Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2025

facts.fact: The Personal Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2025 was assented by the President on 7 November 2025, according to the document.
